description: Fix all Medium severity issues: chat/AI pipeline (HF-011 to HF-019), payment/subscription (HF-025 to HF-030), user model/data (HF-032 to HF-040), rate limiting (HF-041 to HF-048), frontend state (HF-049 to HF-055, HF-057-063), database (HF-064 to HF-071), external services (HF-072 to HF-079), file upload (HF-080-085), cron/background (HF-086-091, HF-100-105), API contract (HF-093-098), config (HF-107-112), logging (HF-113, HF-117-121)
steps: HF-003: In apps/backend/app/api/v1/auth.py in reset_password handler, before saving the new password, add: `if user.verify_password(request.new_password): raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail='New password must be different from current password')`

HF-005: In apps/backend/app/config.py in validate_production_secrets, change the ADMIN_JWT_SECRET check from `logger.warning(...)` to `raise ValueError('ADMIN_JWT_SECRET is required in production for key isolation')` when APP_ENV is production.

HF-011: In apps/backend/app/services/chat_service.py in retrieve_context method, remove the explicit generate_embedding call. Pass sanitized_message directly as the text parameter to search_context since Azure handles vectorization via VectorizableTextQuery.

HF-013: In apps/backend/app/services/chat_service.py in stream_llm, track accumulated full_response during streaming. If an exception occurs after some chunks were yielded, persist what was accumulated so far via save_chat before returning the error.
HF-015: In apps/backend/app/services/chat_service.py, modify the cache check in the non-streaming chat endpoint: only serve cached responses when session_id is None (no active conversation).
HF-016: In apps/backend/app/services/ai/sarvam_client.py in the non-streaming generate method, change max_tokens from 512 to 2048 to match the streaming path.
HF-017: In apps/backend/app/services/ai/router.py in detect_language, change `if assamese_ratio > 0.3 or assamese_chars >= 5:` to `if assamese_ratio > 0.3 and assamese_chars >= 10:`

HF-018: In apps/backend/app/services/chat_service.py after building the full system_prompt with history, add a token budget check. Use estimate_tokens() to verify total prompt fits within model context (4096 for Sarvam, 32000 for Gemini). If over budget, trim history.

HF-025: In apps/backend/app/api/webhooks/razorpay.py, add a content-length check before reading the body: `content_length = int(request.headers.get('content-length', 0)); if content_length > 1_000_000: raise HTTPException(status_code=413, detail='Payload too large')`
HF-027: In apps/backend/app/api/webhooks/razorpay.py, change the idempotency TTL from 604800 (7 days) to 3024000 (35 days).

HF-028: In apps/backend/app/api/webhooks/razorpay.py in the subscription.charged handler, add amount validation: `if amount < 29900: logger.warning(f'Unexpected amount {amount} for sub {sub_id}'); return {'status': 'ignored', 'reason': 'amount_mismatch'}`

HF-029: In apps/backend/app/api/v1/payments.py in verify_payment, after upgrading the user, insert a payment record into the payments collection with user_id, payment_id, order_id, amount, status, and created_at.

HF-032: In apps/backend/app/models/chat.py, replace all `datetime.utcnow` with `lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc)`. Add `from datetime import timezone` import. Change the Message model timestamp, Chat created_at, Chat updated_at, and the add_message method's datetime.utcnow() calls.

HF-034: In apps/backend/app/db/mongo.py in create_indexes, add error handling that raises in production: wrap the email index creation in try/except and if APP_ENV is production, re-raise the exception.
HF-035: In apps/backend/app/models/user.py, change `role: Optional[str] = None` to `role: Optional[Literal['student', 'educator', 'staff', 'admin']] = None`

HF-040: In apps/backend/app/api/v1/users.py in delete_account, add dead letter cleanup: `from app.db.mongo import get_mongo_client; client = get_mongo_client(); db = client[settings.MONGODB_DB_NAME]; await db.dead_letters.delete_many({'user_id': str(user.id)})`

HF-042: In apps/backend/app/api/v1/auth.py in _check_rate_limit, prefer CF-Connecting-IP header. Change the client_ip resolution to check CF-Connecting-IP first: `client_ip = request.headers.get('CF-Connecting-IP') or request.headers.get('X-Real-IP') or ...`
HF-043: In apps/backend/app/api/deps/rate_limit.py, change `datetime.now()` to `datetime.now(timezone.utc)` in the expiry calculation. Add `from datetime import timezone` import.
HF-045: Document the rate limit approach with a comment noting the 1-minute window limitation.
HF-066: In apps/backend/app/models/chat.py, add a compound index [('session_id', 1), ('created_at', -1)] to the Chat model Settings.indexes.
HF-069: In apps/backend/app/db/mongo.py, add retry logic to init_mongo: wrap the connection attempt in a loop with 3 retries and exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 4s).
HF-071: In apps/backend/app/main.py, change the Redis init failure from `logger.warning(...)` to raise in production. Add: `if settings.APP_ENV == 'production': raise`.
HF-075: Add a comment in apps/backend/app/services/ai/vertex_client.py noting the token lock queueing concern and suggesting background refresh as a future improvement.

HF-078: In apps/backend/app/services/ai/sarvam_client.py in stream_generate_with_retry, track if any chunks were yielded. If chunks were already yielded before failure, do not retry (raise immediately since partial content was already sent).

HF-080: In apps/backend/app/api/v1/chat.py in the image upload endpoint, add a comment noting dimension check limitation. Optionally add SVG rejection (HF-081): add `if file.content_type == 'image/svg+xml': raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail='SVG files are not supported')`

HF-100: In apps/backend/app/api/v1/auth.py in the refresh endpoint, use Redis SETNX for atomic token claim. Replace the check-then-revoke pattern with: use `redis.set(f'revoked_refresh:{jti}', '1', ex=..., nx=True)` and if it returns falsy (key existed), the token was already claimed by another request.
HF-101: In apps/backend/app/core/circuit_breaker.py, add an asyncio.Lock for state transitions. Add `self._lock = asyncio.Lock()` in __init__ and use it in the call method.

HF-103: In apps/backend/app/api/webhooks/razorpay.py, change the idempotency approach to two-phase: set initial value as 'processing', after successful handling update to 'completed'. On retry, if value is 'processing' and older than 5 minutes, allow reprocessing.
HF-107: Already covered by HF-005 fix above (ADMIN_JWT_SECRET required in production).
HF-113: In apps/backend/app/core/logging_config.py, add a comment: `# CONTRACT: user_id must always be MongoDB ObjectId, never email or PII`

HF-117: In apps/backend/app/api/v1/auth.py in _check_rate_limit, change `logger.warning(f'Rate limiting unavailable ({endpoint}): {e}')` to `logger.warning(f'Rate limiting unavailable ({endpoint}): {type(e).__name__}')`
HF-118: In apps/backend/app/services/dead_letter.py in store_dead_letter, truncate the message: change `'message': message` to `'message': message[:200]`
HF-119: In apps/backend/app/core/circuit_breaker.py, add rate limiting to state transition logs. Add a `_last_log_time` attribute and only log if more than 60 seconds have passed since last log.

HF-120: In apps/backend/app/api/v1/chat.py and apps/backend/app/utils/tracking.py, for anonymous users use the X-Anon-ID header instead of the string 'anonymous'. Change: `user_id = str(user.id) if user else (http_request.headers.get('X-Anon-ID') or 'anonymous')` in chat.py. Same pattern in streaming endpoint.

HF-121: In apps/backend/app/core/logging_config.py in setup_logging, change the handler removal to only add without removing: replace the removal loop with a check `if not root_logger.handlers:` before adding, or just always add the handler without removing existing ones.
acceptance_criteria: All modified Python files pass syntax check
Language detection uses AND logic with threshold 10
User role field uses Literal type
Setup logging does not remove existing handlers
verification: Run: cd /projects/sandbox/-kalukaliya/apps/backend && python -c "import ast; import glob; [ast.parse(open(f).read()) for f in glob.glob('app/**/*.py', recursive=True)]" to verify all Python files have valid syntax
findings: All 34 medium severity fixes implemented across 18 files. AST syntax verification passes for all Python files. Key changes: auth.py (password reuse, atomic token refresh, CF-Connecting-IP), config.py (ADMIN_JWT_SECRET required), chat.py (token budget, SSE sentinel, cache session check, X-Anon-ID, SVG rejection), razorpay.py (two-phase idempotency, body size limit, amount validation), mongo.py (retry logic, heartbeat, fatal index), circuit_breaker.py (asyncio.Lock, log rate limiting), logging_config.py (preserve handlers, PII contract).
